{{Top|leg}}
The '''Galactic Pest Authority''' was an organization responsible for monitoring reports of vermin, pests and nuisance creatures throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. They could authorize the extermination of these vermin and sometimes did so by hiring independent armed individuals.

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], the Galactic Pest Authority received conclusive evidence of a dangerous rise in the number of vermin on the remote desert world of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. To deal with this development, the authority hired [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to eradicate specific vermin lairs.

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], several missions offered by the The Galactic Pest Authority can be found on mission terminals on Tatooine.
